basic_profile.bio: Avid kayaker and outdoor enthusiast living just north of Nashville, TN. I spend my weekends exploring local rivers and sharing my passion for whitewater kayaking with others. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to hit the water whenever the weather is right. I'm single and enjoy the freedom it brings, allowing me to dedicate time to my hobbies. Typically online during weekday evenings and sporadically throughout the weekend.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have been kayaking for over a decade, starting as a hobby in college. I've attended various kayaking workshops and have read extensively on the subject. My graphic design skills are self-taught, honed over years of freelance work and online courses.
